The '''Khramboans''' were a sentient species from the [[Khramboa system/Legends|Khramboa system]]. [[Droogan/Legends|Droogan]] and his [[Droogan's grandfather/Legends|grandfather]] were both members of this species.

==Biology and appearance==
The Khramboans were a blue-colored species marked by a bipedal stature and had two three-fingered arms, two eyes on horizontal eyestalks and a mouth hidden behind two thick face-tentacles, similar to the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]].

==History==
The Khramboans evolved in the [[Khramboa system/Legends|Khramboa system]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region. Some Khramboans, like [[Droogan/Legends|Droogan]], lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
